data_fields.name: swing_windup_poses
data_fields.donor_constant: reach 2, raise 3, fast swing 3, slow swing 4 (one-handed); 2, 3, 3, 4 poses in two-handed tables

data_fields.name: windup_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: (poses + 1) x frame time, derived by reading the scheduler (not run)

data_fields.name: avatar_flash_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: damage at least strength/3, or health below strength/4, or lightning

best_idea: Let the clip rules (first-frame hold chance, tail loop, time-synched crowd clip, hold on the last frame) and a swing's windup table be data, and derive the strike time from the windup data on the server, not from the client's animation timer.
decision_why: The clip rules and windup table fit creature clips, but the donor lets the actor's own queue decide the strike, which cannot own a server-verified kill.
acceptance: A creature's swing shows its windup poses at the data frame time and the server strike lands at swing start plus the data windup time for each of the four styles, asserted by a server test.
